tools.clang: Android (13624864, +pgo, -bolt, +lto, -mlgo, based on r530567e) clang version 19.0.1

outputs: liba10_gap_<abi>{,_stripped}.so - five shapes beside each other: plainAdd (constant-initialized table; binds everywhere), weakOnly (the fbjni kDescriptor shape: signature word against the weak preemptible OBJECT dynsym a10_weak_descriptor; binds everywhere, REL ABIs too), nounwindAdd (a real wrapper, hidden, no unwind tables: binds on armeabi-v7a where lld backfills an .ARM.exidx CANTUNWIND row, refused on the eh_frame ABIs), smallOnly (the registrar builds the entry at run time through a noinline constructor - no static triple; unbound everywhere), decoyDataFn (fnPtr word against a defined OBJECT; unbound everywhere)
a10-classes.dex - GapNative's five declarations (the join oracle)
a10-jni-gap.apk - the dex plus one copy of the library per ABI, each ABI's own bytes

liba10_nowhere_<abi>{,_stripped}.so + a10-nowhere-classes.dex + a10-jni-nowhere.apk (A10 Q3) - one three-entry table: entry [0] nwShared registered for NwBound with a constant count (the confirmer resolves its range), entries [1,2] nwRt registered for NwRtA/NwRtB through volatile-count stack copies (no resolved range). NwMissing declares nwShared with no registrar anywhere naming it: with --disassemble its ambiguous row carries registered_nowhere; the nwRt rows stay plain ambiguous
oracle: llvm-readelf --dyn-syms plus eh_frame, or .ARM.exidx on v7a (hexdump parsed per PREL31): every recovered fn_addr is a start in its own ABI's bytes; asserted in-repo by tests/test_jni.py::test_gap_fixture_fn_addrs_pass_the_readelf_oracle and at build time on this host. The v7a nounwindAdd row is legitimate, not lucky: readelf -x .ARM.exidx shows the backfilled entry at the wrapper's address (0x173c in this build).
